metadata.title: Results Display with Streaming & Copy Controls

story.iWant: to see generated posts stream in real-time with copy buttons and character counts
story.soThat: I can quickly distribute my content across platforms
story.tasks: - Task 1: Create Results Panel component (AC: 2, 8) - Task 2: Add generated posts state to aiStore (AC: 8) - Task 3: Implement streaming display logic (AC: 3, 10) - Task 4: Auto-activate Results tab on generation start (AC: 1) - Task 5: Implement real-time character counting (AC: 4) - Task 6: Add character limit warnings (AC: 5) - Task 7: Implement copy-to-clipboard functionality (AC: 6, 7) - Task 8: Add loading spinner during generation (AC: 9) - Task 9: Handle parallel display (AC: 2) - Task 10: Handle stream completion (AC: 3, 9) - Task 11: Add clear/reset functionality (Optional enhancement) - Task 12: Implement smooth scrolling (AC: 10) - Task 13: Add error state display (Error handling) - Task 14-15: Write tests for Results Panel and streaming (Testing)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Results tab automatically activated when generation starts 2. Platform sections display in parallel (YouTube, Twitter, LinkedIn) 3. Generated text streams into each section as API returns chunks 4. Real-time character count displayed below each platform's text 5. Warning indicator if character count exceeds limits (Twitter: 280, LinkedIn: 3000) 6. Individual "Copy to Clipboard" button per platform (shadcn/ui Button) 7. Copy button shows confirmation feedback ("Copied!") on click 8. Generated content remains in view until session ends or cleared 9. Loading spinner shown while generation in progress 10. Smooth UI updates during streaming (no flickering/jumping)

docs.doc: Defines ResultsPanel.tsx for streaming results display with copy controls and character counting.

artifact.reason: State management for generatedPosts object with appendStreamChunk action
Auto-activate Results tab when generation starts

package.name: lucide-react
package.reason: Icons for copy button and warnings

story-context.constraints: - Streaming Display: Real-time UI updates as IPC events arrive, smooth animations prevent flickering - State Management: Zustand aiStore accumulates stream chunks per platform via appendStreamChunk action - Character Counting: Derived value from content length, no separate state - Character Limits: Twitter 280, LinkedIn 3000, YouTube no limit (show count) - Copy-to-Clipboard: Use navigator.clipboard API with permission handling - Parallel Display: All platform sections visible simultaneously, update independently - Auto-scroll: Smooth scroll to latest content, respect user manual scroll

interface.name: aiStore.generatedPosts
interface.signature: generatedPosts: {youtube: string; twitter: string; linkedin: string}

interfaces.interface: Appends streaming chunk to platform content

tests.standards: Component tests for ResultsPanel with simulated IPC events. Test streaming updates, character counting, warnings, copy functionality. Integration tests for streaming flow.
tests.ideas: - AC 1: Test Results tab auto-activated on generation start - AC 2, 9: Test all platform sections render in parallel - AC 3: Test streaming chunks update UI in real-time (simulate IPC events) - AC 4: Test character count updates as content streams in - AC 5: Test warnings display when exceeding limits (Twitter 280, LinkedIn 3000) - AC 6, 7: Test copy-to-clipboard functionality with "Copied!" feedback - AC 8: Test generated content persists until cleared - AC 9: Test loading spinner shown/hidden during generation - AC 10: Test smooth UI updates (no flickering)
